phase: Phase 2: Production-wiring scope & dead work (Cluster B)
summary: Final acceptance gate for Phase 2 (Cluster B — production-wiring scope & dead work). All three substantive FRs are provably Green and corroborated by independent re-runs of all configured gates: FR-4 (multi-module projection via the shared loadFullCurriculumGraph helper, 574 nodes / 2708 edges, replaces module-1 JSON imports in both convex/student.ts and convex/parent/visualization.ts); FR-5 (dead student_competency read deleted from getStudentVisualizationHandler, spy test removed, JSDoc corrected — remaining student_competency references at student.ts:212/224 are inside the completePhase mutation and out of Phase 2 scope per strategy §14); FR-6 (review_due literal removed from both handlers' learnerState unions and from EMPTY_LEARNER_STATE; no producer change required because no branch ever wrote it). All four prior audits (review-a-phase2, review-b-phase2, review-c-phase2, phase-acceptance-phase2) returned status=pass. Adversarial testing (commit 776a8c63) ran 9 probes / 9 PASS / 0 bypass findings — the single documented limitation (PROBE-3 short-relative-path require not matched by the arch-lint regex) is a future-proofing note, not an active bypass at HEAD (both handlers now use loadFullCurriculumGraph and reference no module-1 paths). Live re-verification in this audit: (a) FR-3 guard on apps/ packages/ convex/ → 2244 files / 664 typed tags / 0 violations / exit 0 (Phase 1 invariant preserved); (b) git grep -nP 'curriculum/skill-graph/module-1/(nodes|edges)\.json' under apps/integrated-math-3/convex/ → 0 matches; (c) git grep -nE "['\"]review_due['\"]" on student.ts + parent/visualization.ts → 0 matches; (d) targeted vitest on the 5 Phase-2 files (studentVisualization, studentVisualizationAdversarial, studentVisualizationMultiModule, skill-graph-loader, visualizationLearnerStateUnion) → 26/26 PASS in 16.5s; (e) tsc --noEmit on apps/integrated-math-3 → 318 errors total, matching documented baseline exactly (0 new errors introduced by Phase 2); (f) eslint --max-warnings 0 on the 8 changed/added files → 0 errors, 0 warnings; (g) git status --short on apps/ packages/ convex/ → empty (no unstaged production changes); (h) plan.md tasks 2.1, 2.2, 2.3 all marked [x] with commit-SHA evidence reachable in git; task 2.4 UMV correctly [ ] (user-driven, runs after this gate per workflow.md). No spec drift: FR-4 followed the test-strategy §12 binding decision (use root nodes.json/edges.json); FR-5 followed §13 option-b (delete-only, no replacement test); FR-6 followed §13 (narrow at handler boundary, do not produce). No blocking findings; no remediation required.

nonblocking_findings.description: Phase-acceptance NB-1: Review-A's documented vitest timeout in visualizationLearnerStateUnion.test.ts was already fixed in commit aee13927 by hoisting getStudentVisualizationHandler to a static import. Current run: 3/3 PASS in 88ms (well under 5s default). Resolved, retained for traceability.

Phase-acceptance NB-2: components/parent/ParentDashboard.tsx still references 'module-1' and 'review_due' in UI switch cases. These are intentional — the UI consumes the broader VisualNodeV1 schema union (separate from the narrowed handler-internal union) and is not in Phase 2 scope. Deferred for tracking.

Phase-acceptance NB-3: studentVisualization.test.ts retains a harmless `student_competency: []` mock-ctx entry; the spy assertion test that referenced it was deleted. Strategy §14 explicitly permits 'leave intact OR remove' at Green's discretion. Not a blocker.

Adversarial PROBE-3 documented one regex limitation: the arch-lint guard in studentVisualizationMultiModule.test.ts will not detect a future `require('./module-1/...')` short-relative-path bypass (no skill-graph/ prefix). Not an active bypass at HEAD — both handlers use loadFullCurriculumGraph() and reference no module-1 paths. Recorded for awareness; no fix required.

Review-A NB-1: skill-graph-loader.test.ts uses `expect(nodes.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(500)` rather than pinning the exact 574-node count. Satisfies the test-strategy contract but slightly weaker than the checklist's '574' wording. Real on-disk count is confirmed 574/2708.
